summary: Baltic Fresh Foods Ltd. presented its operations report for the third quarter of 2026. The company achieved a revenue of EUR 4,850,000, while operating costs amounted to EUR 3,920,000. Capital expenditure totaled USD 310,000, primarily directed toward temperature sensors and electric vans. Additionally, Northern Cold Chain AB extended its framework agreement until 2028.
keyPoints: Q3 2026 revenue reached EUR 4,850,000 and operating costs were EUR 3,920,000
Capital expenditure amounted to USD 310,000 for sensors and electric vans
Cold-chain utilisation remained above target throughout the quarter
Migration of route planning to the new telematics platform was completed
Northern Cold Chain AB extended the framework agreement until 2028
The next operating review is scheduled for 15 December 2026
